# Module `regex`

regex - POSIX extended regular expressions over String bytes.

Thin wrappers over the runtime's `__vyb_regex_*` functions in
`runtime/vyb_runtime.c`. Matching and the offsets returned by `regex_find` are
byte-based, in line with the Vyb String model, so providers parsing HTML/URL
text can rely on the same indices as the rest of the stdlib. A pattern that
does not match (or does not compile) yields the "no match" form of each
helper: 0 / -1 / "" / the unchanged input.
